analysis:
Examined all supplied test additions, patches, file metadata and fixture BASE source against the indexed threat model and detailed T-041. No concrete regression is established by these test-only changes.
RegistrationWeightHashTests.swift:28–51 expects managed GLM registration to reuse a persisted hash without reading weights, then rehash after an ordinary write; :54–73 checks uncached fallbacks. Integration must inspect registrationWeightHash and record validation against adversarial record/file modification, hash-to-loaded-artifact binding and concurrent writes (A-004, T-012, T-027, T-041). These tests do not establish those controls or their absence.
PageCacheTests.swift:36–58 checks eviction, unchanged bytes, SHA-256 correctness and empty/missing handling. OS page-cache eviction is not evidence of plaintext/GPU erasure (T-028); PageCache and WeightHasher implementations remain outside this batch.
GLM5NextWiredLimitTests.swift:26–63 restricts recommendations to 256 GiB M5 hosts and tests unreadable limits; :66–105 compares fixed sysctl/LaunchDaemon text without executing it. Integration should examine actual advice generation and memory admission together: raising system-wide wired limits must not replace provider resource guards. No injected command or privileged execution is visible here.
NativeOutputControlRefusalTests.swift:11–61 checks capability-dependent logprob admission, constraint refusal and typed 400 errors versus untyped 500 failures. Verify both real submit paths and bounded logprob capture in integration; tests alone do not prove breaker behavior at the coordinator.
GLM5NextProtectedFactoryFixture.swift adds only atomic thinking-token vocabulary entries at HEAD:111–112. BASE:136–186 derives fixture artifact/prompt identities from generated files; existing scoped cache and retirement cleanup remain unchanged. No new authorization, encryption, billing or tenant-isolation behavior is directly implemented in this scope. Deeper review is needed for the material persisted-hash contract and runtime interactions identified above, not because missing source proves a vulnerability.
